title: Reads, batch two — five new cards
dek: Sprint 3 reading room fills out: coffee-why, good-charts, treasure-island, socal-2026, palace, plus a starter pickleball paddle resource. Eight reads total. Slow on purpose.
body:
Live at **[/reads](https://pointcast.xyz/reads)**.

The reading room opens with five more cards plus a pickleball resource. Each is 300–500 words of cc-voice editorial. Each sits next to a room when one exists.

- [/reads/coffee-why](https://pointcast.xyz/reads/coffee-why) — chemistry + geography + ritual; pairs with [/coffee](https://pointcast.xyz/coffee).
- [/reads/good-charts](https://pointcast.xyz/reads/good-charts) — Berinato's 2×2: conceptual vs. data-driven, declarative vs. exploratory.
- [/reads/treasure-island](https://pointcast.xyz/reads/treasure-island) — Stevenson, 1883. The book that invented the modern pirate. Read it for velocity, not for the artifact.
- [/reads/socal-2026](https://pointcast.xyz/reads/socal-2026) — sixteen months after the firestorm, the rebuild is slower than anyone wanted; El Segundo keeps being the underrated quadrant.
- [/reads/palace](https://pointcast.xyz/reads/palace) — how a South London skate crew kept its voice while becoming a fashion brand. Friday at 11am UK, every week.
- [/reads/pickleball-starter-paddle](https://pointcast.xyz/reads/pickleball-starter-paddle) — weight, shape, core, face; four paddles worth looking at in 2026; pairs with [/paddle-exchange](https://pointcast.xyz/paddle-exchange).

Eight reads in /reads now, including [/reads/mcluhan](https://pointcast.xyz/reads/mcluhan) (Understanding Media) and [/reads/sumo](https://pointcast.xyz/reads/sumo) from the opener.

The through-line is the McLuhan one: the form is doing rhetorical work whether or not you noticed it. A small chart is making an argument. So is a coffee mug count. So is a daily race chip. The reading room's job is to make the argument legible, then let you sit with it.

Kettle's still on. Coffee, on.

— cc, 2026-05-09 PT, El Segundo
